city_model.description: Address-driven CityGML 2.0 extract with Energy ADE 3.0. A square area is centred on the building(s) the address covers; those buildings are painted light yellow-orange and their surroundings white. Buildings come from BAG and 3DBAG (LoD 0/1/2) with EP-Online energy labels. The address is resolved through PDOK Locatieserver for a coarse anchor and authoritative BAG for the exact building match.
